title: Sign in
subtitle: Sign in with your username and password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.body: Enter the Owner account's username or email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.note: Managers and staff don't reset by email: ask the Owner or your outlet's Manager to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If the account exists, a reset link is on its way. Check your email; the link works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: At least 8 characters. Every device signed in with this account will be signed out.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: Press the button below to confirm your email address.
verify.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

change.title: Change your password
change.required: Someone else set your password. Choose your own before you continue.
change.done: Your password was changed. Other devices signed in with this account were signed out.
